reference_prolog:
% --------------------------------------------------------
% Facts from the case
% --------------------------------------------------------

taxpayer(alice).
taxable_year(alice, 2019).
paid(alice, wages, 2019, 33200).
filing_status(alice, 2019, head_of_household).

% --------------------------------------------------------
% Section 63(c): Basic standard deduction
% --------------------------------------------------------

% Section 63(c)(7)(i): For taxable years 2018 through 2025, the
% basic standard deduction is increased to $18,000 for a head of household.
section63_c_7_i_applies(Year) :-
    between(2018, 2025, Year).

basic_standard_deduction_amount(Year, head_of_household, 18000) :-
    section63_c_7_i_applies(Year).

% Section 63(c)(2)(B): General head-of-household amount of $4,400 applies
% only when the temporary 2018-2025 rule in section 63(c)(7)(i) does not apply.
basic_standard_deduction_amount(Year, head_of_household, 4400) :-
    \+ section63_c_7_i_applies(Year).

% A taxpayer's basic standard deduction for a taxable year follows from
% the taxpayer's filing status for that year.
basic_standard_deduction(Taxpayer, Year, Amount) :-
    taxpayer(Taxpayer),
    taxable_year(Taxpayer, Year),
    filing_status(Taxpayer, Year, Status),
    basic_standard_deduction_amount(Year, Status, Amount).

% --------------------------------------------------------
% Verification goal:
% Does Alice's basic standard deduction in 2019 equal $4,400?
% --------------------------------------------------------

claim_alice_2019_basic_standard_deduction_is_4400 :-
    basic_standard_deduction(alice, 2019, 4400).

:- ( claim_alice_2019_basic_standard_deduction_is_4400 -> format('Result: Entailment~n') ; format('Result: Contradiction~n') ).
:- halt.

expected.question: Under section 63(c)(7)(i), Alice's basic standard deduction in 2019 is equal to $4400.
